course_name_original: Artificial Intelligence and Neural Networks in Applications
course_name_en: Artificial Intelligence and Neural Networks in Applications
syllabus_topics: What is the purpose of AI, what AI can do now and what impact it has on society.
State space and methods for solving typical problems.
State space - search complexity and how to face it.
Machine learning and its basic algorithms. Clustering.
Learning from classified data. Combination of classifiers.
Problem solving theory and the use of formal logic.
Deep learning, convolutional neural networks, influence of architecture
Neural networks for natural language processing, RNN, LSTM; Transformers.
The topics of the seminaries follow the topics of lectures.
assessment_rules: Students must attend at least 70% of the labs. Three out of five assigned individual tasks must be submitted by the deadline, which is 14 days from the beginning of the examination period. Students have 14 days to submit each task, earning maximum points if submitted on time. Points decrease by 1 per day of delay until reaching 0 points. These earned points contribute to the overall evaluation for the final exam.
